title: Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2611.32997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. translated_title: 通过大语言模型训练建模双语学习：一项关键期探索研究
translated_abstract: 二语（L2）习得的关键期理论表明，学习一门新语言的能力可能取决于先前习得的第一语言（L1）知识被修改的难易程度。这项探索性计算研究通过考察内部表征而非行为表现，将神经网络语言模型方法扩展至关键期效应的研究。一个小型两层GPT-2模型首先在英语上训练，随后通过顺序训练或弹性权重固化学习德语（相对相近的二语）或芬兰语（相对较远的二语），后者限制了英语相关重要参数的变化。在第一和第二个二语训练轮次后，研究将每种语言20个保留探测句的平均池化隐藏状态与纯英语模型的隐藏状态进行了比较，采用余弦相似度在嵌入层和两个Transformer层进行测量。英语相似度在Transformer层中保持较高，但在嵌入层中变为负值。
tldr: 该研究通过让小型GPT-2模型依次学习英语和不同距离的第二语言，并分析内部隐藏状态的余弦相似度，从模型内部表征角度探索了二语习得的关键期效应。
en_tdlr: This study explores critical-period effects in second-language acquisition by sequentially training a small GPT-2 model on English and a related or distant L2, analyzing internal representations through cosine similarity of hidden states.
